signature.name: VTask.irrelevant
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {σ : Type u_2} -> {A : Type u_3} -> [Semiring A] -> [DecidableEq ι] -> [AddCommMonoid ι] -> [PartialOrder ι] -> [CanonicallyOrderedAdd ι] -> [SetLike σ A] -> [AddSubmonoidClass σ A] -> (𝒜 : ι → σ) -> [GradedRing 𝒜] -> HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for any graded ring satisfying the stated hypotheses, with no special-casing needed at boundary inputs.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι σ A : Type*} [Semiring A] [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommMonoid ι] [PartialOrder ι] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd ι] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubmonoidClass σ A] (𝒜 : ι → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜], (VTask.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal = Ideal.span (⋃ i > 0, (𝒜 i : Set A))
